title: Arabic Fattoush Salad
description: This fattoush recipe is a colorful tossed salad with a lemony garlic dressing. Fattoush is one of the most well-known Middle Eastern salads and a standard dish on the mezza (small dishes) table. If you've never made a single Arabic dish, this is a delicious and healthy place to start.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Working in batches, fry pita pieces in hot oil until golden brown on both sides. Blot dry with paper towels and set aside.
Combine cucumber, tomatoes, parsley, mint, red onion, olive oil, lemon juice, sumac, garlic, salt, and ground black pepper in a large serving bowl. Gently toss salad with fried pita pieces.
Grate feta cheese on top using a small cheese grater to serve.
ingredients: 2 small (4 inch) pita breads, torn into pieces
2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, or to taste
1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, or to taste
1 teaspoon ground sumac, or to taste
1 clove garlic, crushed, or more to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

title: Broccoli And Chicken Stir-Fry
description: This chicken and broccoli recipe is easy to make by stir-frying chicken pieces with fresh broccoli in a mix of soy, ginger, garlic, and brown sugar. Serve with rice for an easy, pleasing dinner.
steps: Gather all ingredients.

Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmery, about 2 minutes. Meanwhile, stir together chicken and 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch in a medium bowl until chicken is coated.

Add chicken to skillet in a single layer and cook, stirring often, until crisp and cooked through, about 6 minutes. Add onions, and cook, stirring often, until translucent, about 1 minute. Add ginger and garlic; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer chicken mixture to a plate and set aside.
Add broccoli to empty skillet, and cook over medium-high, stirring occasionally, until bright green and heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk together water, soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, crushed red pepper, black pepper, and remaining 2 tablespoons cornstarch in a small bowl until smooth, about 30 seconds.
Add cooked chicken mixture to broccoli in skillet; add soy sauce mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until broccoli and chicken are well coated, and sauce thickens, about 2 minutes.
Serve immediately. Enjoy!
ingredients: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 3/4-inch pieces
¼ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste

title: Spicy Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
description: This version of a classic Thai dish offers fantastic flavor, even with regular basil instead of the traditional Thai or holy basil. The sauce works as a glaze while the chicken cooks over high heat. For the best results, it’s recommended to chop or grind your own chicken and have all ingredients prepared before starting to cook.
steps: Gather ingredients.
Whisk chicken broth, oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, white sugar, and brown sugar together in a bowl until well blended.
Heat large skillet over high heat. Drizzle in oil. Add chicken and stir fry until it loses its raw color, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in shallots, garlic, and sliced chilies. Continue cooking on high heat until some of the juices start to caramelize in the bottom of the pan, about 2 or 3 more minutes.
Add about a tablespoon of the sauce mixture to the skillet; cook and stir until sauce begins to caramelize, about 1 minute.
Pour in the rest of the sauce. Cook and stir until sauce has deglazed the bottom of the pan. Continue to cook until sauce glazes onto the meat, 1 or 2 more minutes. Remove from heat.
Stir in basil. Cook and stir until basil is wilted, about 20 seconds. Serve with rice.
Serve hot and enjoy!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon soy sauce, or as needed
1 pound skinless, boneless chicken thighs, coarsely chopped
2 tablespoons minced Thai chilies, Serrano, or other hot pepper
1 cup very thinly sliced fresh basil leaves

title: General Tso's Chicken
description: General Tso's chicken is crispy, twice-fried chicken in a deliciously sweet and sticky glaze. This mouthwatering dish delivers a combination of Asian flavors that will knock your chopsticks off! Serve with steamed broccoli and white rice and garnish with sliced green onions.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Whisk egg in large mixing bowl. Add chicken, salt, sugar, and pepper; mix well. Mix in cornstarch, a little bit at a time, until chicken is well coated.

Working in batches, carefully drop one piece of chicken at a time into the hot oil. Fry until chicken turns golden brown and begins to float, about 3 minutes. Remove chicken to a plate and allow to cool as you fry the next batch.

Once all of the chicken has been fried, refry the chicken, starting with the batch that was cooked first. Fry each batch until chicken turns deep golden brown, about 2 minutes more. Drain on a paper towel-lined plate.

Prepare sauce: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Stir in green onion, garlic, whole chiles, and orange zest. Cook and stir until garlic turns golden and chiles brighten, 1 to 2 minutes.

Add sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth, peanut oil, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and ginger; bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes. Whisk 2 teaspoons of cornstarch in water until dissolved. Stir into the boiling sauce. Return to a boil and cook until the sauce thickens and is no longer cloudy from the cornstarch, about 1 minute.
Stir chicken into the boiling sauce. Reduce heat to low and cook until chicken is heated through and has absorbed some of the sauce, about 3 minutes.
Serve with Brocolli and/or Steamed rice and enjoy!
ingredients: 1 ½ pounds skinless, boneless chicken thighs, cut into 1 ½-inch pieces

title: Orange Chicken
description: This orange chicken recipe is sticky, sweet, and delicious. It tastes similar to the orange chicken from a popular Chinese restaurant in the mall! It's easier to make than you think for delicious takeout at home.
steps: Gather all ingredients.

Combine water, rice vinegar, lemon juice, soy sauce, and orange juice for sauce into a saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir in brown sugar, green onion, orange zest, ginger, garlic, and pepper flakes; bring to a boil. Remove from heat, and cool for 10 to 15 minutes.
Place chicken in a resealable plastic bag. Pour in 1 cup cooled sauce. Seal the bag, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Reserve the remaining sauce.
Mix flour, salt, and pepper in another resealable plastic bag.
Remove chicken from the marinade and place into the bag of seasoned flour. Seal the bag and shake to coat.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken in the hot skillet until browned on both sides.
Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and cover with aluminum foil. Wipe out the skillet.
Pour reserved sauce into the skillet and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Mix together cornstarch and water until completely smooth. Stir into the boiling sauce.
Reduce heat to medium-low, add the chicken, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Serve over rice and enjoy!
ingredients: ½ teaspoon minced fresh ginger root
2 large skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into ½-inch cubes

title: World's Best Lasagna
description: This lasagna recipe takes a little work, but it is so satisfying and filling that it's worth it!
steps: Gather all your ingredients.
Cook sausage, ground beef, onion, and garlic in the oven over medium heat until well browned.

Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, and water. Season with sugar, 2 tablespoons parsley, basil, 1 teaspoon salt, Italian seasoning, fennel seeds, and pepper. Simmer, covered, for about 1 ½ hours, stirring occasionally.
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes. Drain noodles, and rinse with cold water.
In a mixing bowl, combine ricotta cheese with egg, remaining 2 tablespoons parsley, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

To assemble, spread 1 ½ cups of meat sauce in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Arrange 6 noodles lengthwise over meat sauce, overlapping slightly. Spread with 1/2 of the ricotta cheese mixture. Top with 1/3 of the mozzarella cheese slices. Spoon 1 ½ cups meat sauce over mozzarella, and sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Repeat layers, and top with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil: to prevent sticking, either spray foil with cooking spray or make sure the foil does not touch the cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 25 minutes.
Rest lasagna for 15 minutes before serving.
ingredients: 1 ½ teaspoons salt, divided, or to taste

title: Apple Beetroot Carrot juice
description: ABC juice is Apple beetroot carrot juice with ginger and lemon to balance the flavour and taste.
steps: Peel beetroot and carrot. Chop them roughly along with the apple.
Place chopped items along with ginger in a mixie.
Blend without water and strain through a metal strainer.
Again add ¾ cup to 1 cup water and blend. Strain through a metal strainer.
Squeeze lemon, add salt, mix, and enjoy.

title: Black Bean and Corn Salad
description: This black bean and corn salad is very colourful and includes a delicious lime and garlic dressing.
steps: Gather the ingredients.
lace olive oil, lime juice, garlic, salt, and cayenne pepper in a small jar. Close the lid tightly and shake the jar until the dressing is well combined.
Combine in a salad bowl beans, corn, avocado, bell pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and cilantro.
Shake dressing again, pour over salad, and toss to coat. \u0026amp; Enjoy!
ingredients: 2 (15 ounce) cans black beans, rinsed and drained

title: Greek Salad
description: Greek Salad is easy to make and bursting with flavour. With only six ingredients — cucumbers, tomatoes, bell pepper, red onion, olives, and feta — it is a healthy salad recipe.
steps: Add the cucumber, tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, olives, and feta cheese to a large mixing bowl.

In a separate small mixing bowl, add the vinegar, lemon juice, mustard, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Slowly add the olive oil and whisk vigorously while pouring until the dressing is emulsified.
Drizzle the dressing on the salad and gently stir to combine. Season with additional salt and pepper, if desired.
ingredients: Greek Salad Dressing⅓ cup red wine vinegar

title: Loaded Breakfast Skillet
description: This breakfast skillet is loaded with potatoes, smoked beef, onions, eggs, and shredded cheese for a hearty and delicious breakfast or brunch dish.
steps: Cook meat strips in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels, reserving most of the fat in the skillet.
Crumble the meat strips and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Add diced onion to the reserved fat and cook, stirring, until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.
Add potatoes to the skillet. Toss to coat evenly in fat. Pour in water and cover the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
Mix in green onions, garlic, and paprika. Season with table salt and black pepper to taste.
Using a wooden spoon, make 4 wells in the potato mixture, revealing the bottom of the skillet.
Crack an egg into each well. Season with table salt and black pepper.
Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese and crumbled meat over the entire skillet. Cover and cook until the egg whites are set, but the yolks remain runny, about 5 minutes.
Serve immediately and enjoy!
ingredients: 4 slices smoked beef/mutton strips, cut into 1-inch pieces
3 russet potatoes, scrubbed, chopped into 3/4-inch cubes
table salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

title: Avocado Breakfast Sandwich
description: Make this egg and avocado sandwich for a tasty breakfast at home! It's quick, easy, and packed with protein. The sliced avocado adds a unique flavour, making this sandwich both delicious and filling.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Crack eggs into the skillet and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Flip and cook the eggs until done, about 2 to 5 minutes more. Transfer the eggs to a plate and season with salt and pepper.
Spread butter onto one side of each bread slice.
Heat a skillet over medium heat. Lay one slice of bread in the hot skillet, butter-side down.
Quickly layer the sandwich with Swiss cheese, 1 fried egg, Cheddar cheese, 1 fried egg, avocado slices, and the remaining bread slice, butter-side up.
Carefully flip the sandwich to grill the other side until golden brown, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Remove the sandwich from the skillet and cut it in half. Serve and enjoy!

title: Easy Breakfast Tortilla Pizza
description: This hearty breakfast tortilla pizza could not be easier! Think breakfast burrito with a toasty outside. It's perfect for feeding kids and they can customise their own breakfast pizza as they like.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Rub butter along the bottom and sides of an 8- or 9-inch cake pan.
Press the tortilla into the buttered pan, ensuring it fits snugly along the bottom and sides.
Crack each egg onto the tortilla, keeping them next to each other.
Sprinkle the eggs with salt and pepper, then evenly add your desired toppings.
Bake in the preheated oven until the egg whites are set, and the tortilla is lightly browned and toasted along the edges and bottom, about 13 to 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven, serve, and enjoy!
ingredients: 1/2 cup total assorted toppings, such as cheese, hot sauce, cooked meat or veggies

title: Croissant French Toast
description: This croissant French toast makes an easy and impressive breakfast or brunch. It's the perfect choice for special occasions or holidays. Serve warm with berries, maple syrup, or your favourite toppings.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°F (95°C).
In a shallow bowl, whisk together eggs, half-and-half, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, salt, and nutmeg.
Dip each croissant half into the egg mixture, one at a time, flipping it and lightly pressing down to ensure it is well coated.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add four croissant halves, cut-side down.
Fry the croissants until browned on both sides, turning once, about 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Transfer the cooked croissants to the oven to keep warm while you cook the remaining croissants.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings and enjoy!
ingredients: 4 large croissants, halved horizontally, left out overnight
2 teaspoons vanilla extract or a dash from a vanilla pod.

title: Baba Ganoush
description: Baba ganoush is a creamy, savory roasted eggplant dip from the Middle East and Eastern Mediterranean. With its smoky flavor, it’s perfect for pairing with fresh vegetables or spreading on bread.
steps: Roast the eggplants. Turn your stovetop to medium-high heat and place the eggplants above the flames. Use tongs to rotate the eggplants every 3 to 4 minutes. Roast for about 15 minutes, until the skin is deeply charred and the eggplant starts to deflate.
Steam the eggplants. Place the roasted eggplants in a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let them steam and cool for 15 minutes to allow excess liquid to be removed.
Scoop and chop the flesh. Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh onto a cutting board. Roughly chop the flesh to break apart the stringy bits.

Mix everything together. Add the chopped eggplants to a large mixing bowl and use a fork to mash it into a chunky consistency. Stir in tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and parsley until well combined.
Garnish and serve. Transfer the Baba Ganoush to a small serving bowl, garnish with extra chopped parsley and a drizzle of olive oil.
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants (approx. 2 to 2 ½ pounds total)
¼ teaspoon salt (or more to taste)

title: Shakshuka
description: Shakshuka is a simple, healthy dish popular in the Middle East and North Africa. It combines simmered tomatoes, onions, garlic, and spices with gently poached eggs. Nourishing and filling, it’s a recipe you’ll want to make often.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium heat. Add the diced bell pepper and onion, and cook for 5 minutes or until the onion becomes translucent.
Add the garlic, paprika, cumin, and chili powder. Cook for an additional minute, allowing the spices to bloom.
Pour the can of whole peeled tomatoes and juice into the pan. Break down the tomatoes using a large spoon. Season with salt and pepper, and bring the sauce to a simmer.

Use the spoon to make small wells in the sauce. Crack the eggs into each well. Cook for 5 to 8 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your liking. You can cover the pan with a lid to expedite the cooking process.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and parsley before serving. Serve warm with bread or your favorite sides.
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and diced

title: Classic Hummus
description: This hummus recipe is not only fast and easy, but it’s also super creamy and delicious. It’s the classic hummus you know and love – made from a handful of wholesome ingredients – and it’s done in under three minutes with a high-powered blender!
steps: Add all the ingredients to a high-powered blender and secure the lid. Remove the lid cap and insert the tamper.
Turn the blender on high for 30 seconds (or more for a creamier texture) and use the tamper to push the hummus into the blades. Add more chickpea liquid (aquafaba), if desired, for a softer hummus.
Add the hummus to a small serving bowl and garnish with olive oil, paprika and fresh parsley.
Lisa’s Tips
Don’t forget that you can also make tahini yourself (rather than buying in the store). Just follow my tahini recipe.
The Vitamix blender I use is the Vitamix Ascent 3500 – and I love it!
cup of dried chickpeas = 3 cups of soaked and cooked chickpeas = approx 30 ounces canned chickpeas
ingredients: 2 (15-ounce cans) chickpeas, drained with liquid reserved
▢⅓ cup chickpea liquid, or more, as needed

title: Falafel
description: These Falafel will be crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, made from chickpeas and herbs. A popular dish in many cuisines, they can be served in wraps, pitas, or salads. You can choose between frying or baking them, depending on your preference!
steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight or for at least 8 to 12 hours. Make sure to cover them with plenty of water as they will triple in size. After soaking, drain and rinse the chickpeas.

Add the soaked chickpeas, roughly chopped onion, parsley, cilantro, garlic, green pepper, and spices (cumin, salt, cardamom, black pepper) to a food processor. Pulse until the mixture resembles coarse sand, ensuring it’s not a smooth paste.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and add chickpea flour and baking soda. Stir to combine. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour to firm up the mixture.

Use your hands or a scoop to form the mixture into balls or patties. If the mixture is too wet, add more chickpea flour. If it’s too dry, add a teaspoon or two of water or lemon juice to bring it together.
Heat 3 inches of oil in a pot over medium heat to 350°F (175°C). Fry the falafel in batches of 6-8 for 1-2 minutes until golden brown on the outside.
Remove the falafel with a skimmer and drain them on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Serve the falafel immediately, while warm and crispy on the outside. They’re delicious with tahini sauce or in pita bread. Enjoy!
ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas, soaked overnight (preferably uncanned chickpeas)
1 cup roughly chopped parsley (about one large bunch)
1 cup roughly chopped cilantro (about one large bunch)
1 small green chile pepper (serrano or jalapeño)

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce with Ground Beef
steps: Place lemon slices into a large punch bowl. Pour sugar over the top of lemons. Using a potato masher or wooden spoon, pound lemons and sugar mixture until sugar is dissolved and lemon slices are broken.
Add ice cubes and stir in cold water until sugar is dissolved.
Serve in tall glasses. Garnish each with a fresh mint sprig and maraschino cherry.

title: Green Papaya Salad
description: Cucumber can replace the green papaya in this salad recipe.
steps: Note: Cucumber can replace the green papaya in this salad recipe.

Combine garlic, chiles, and green beans in a mortar and pound roughly with the pestle. Add papaya and pound again to bruise the ingredients. Stir in fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar, then pound again. Add tomato and pound to combine. Stir in chopped peanuts and serve.
ingredients: 1 large unripe papaya, peeled and cut into thin strips
2 tablespoons finely chopped unsalted, dry-roasted peanuts

title: Party Lemonade
description: An easy to make fresh party lemonade recipe for a crowd. Garnish with a fresh mint sprig.
steps: Place lemon slices into a large punch bowl. Pour sugar over the top of lemons. Using a potato masher or wooden spoon, pound lemons and sugar mixture until sugar is dissolved and lemon slices are broken.
Add ice cubes and stir in cold water until sugar is dissolved.
Serve in tall glasses. Garnish each with a fresh mint sprig and maraschino cherry.
ingredients: 12 lemons, thinly sliced and seeds removed

title: Apple Orchard Punch
description: This quick and easy whole-family-friendly punch would be delightful at an in-house event or any celebration.
steps: In a large punch bowl, combine apple juice, cranberry and orange juice. Stir until dissolved, then slowly pour in the ginger ale.
Thinly slice the apple vertically, forming whole apple slices. Float apple slices on top of punch.
ingredients: 1 (32 fluid ounce) bottle apple juice, chilled

title: Cowboy Spaghetti
description: This cowboy spaghetti is a crowd-pleaser, featuring beef strips, cheese, and pasta in a flavourful spicy beef and tomato sauce. The best part is that it’s a one-dish meal, all cooked in a cast iron skillet.
steps: Place the smoked beef strips in a large cast-iron skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until slightly crisp, about 7 minutes. Transfer the cooked strips to a paper towel-lined plate. Once cool enough to handle, crumble the strips roughly and set aside.
Add onion to the same skillet with Smoked Beef Strips grease and sauté until softened, about 3 minutes. Add garlic, salt, and pepper. Stir until garlic is fragrant, about 30 seconds.

Add ground beef. Cook and stir until beef is crumbly and no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Lower heat to medium-low, and stir in beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, and hot sauce. Stir in 1/2 of the crumbled Smoked Beef Strips.

Break spaghetti noodles in half. Scatter over ground beef, making sure noodles are separated. Pour tomatoes with green chiles, fire-roasted tomatoes, and tomato sauce over noodles. Cover and cook for 20 minutes.

Remove the lid and stir to combine the pasta and sauce. Smooth out mixture and scatter shredded cheese evenly over top. Sprinkle with remaining Smoked Beef Strips. Cover and let cheese melt, about 5 minutes. Garnish with green onions; serve immediately.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons hot sauce, or to taste
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chiles
3 green onions, sliced, or as needed for garnish

title: Tomato Basil Penne Pasta
description: This penne pasta is a Mediterranean-style recipe. Use 2 tablespoons olive oil if basil oil is unavailable.
steps: Gather all ingredients.
Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil over high heat. Cook pasta in boiling water until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Heat both oils in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and cook until soft, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in pepper Jack, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese.
When cheese begins to melt, mix in cooked penne pasta.
Season with fresh basil. \u0026amp; Enjoy!

title: Watermelon Salad with Feta
description: This chunky watermelon salad with feta, arugula, red onion, and tomatoes is a hit with everyone, including kids, thanks to the refreshing sweetness of the watermelon!
steps: Whisk olive oil, vinegar, and salt together in a large mixing bowl. Add tomatoes, arugula, and red onion; toss to coat. Gently stir in watermelon and feta cheese to serve.
ingredients: 4 ounces feta cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes

title: Mediterranean Baked Feta
description: This baked feta is a go-to appetizer that’s easy to make and always a crowd-pleaser. The warm, soft feta pairs perfectly with a flavourful topping, making each bite a delightful combination of creamy and savoury goodness.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Place the feta cheese in a small baking dish.
In a medium mixing bowl, add the olives, sun-dried tomatoes, oil, garlic, oregano, thyme, basil, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Stir until well mixed.
Pour the topping all over the feta making sure it\u0026#39;s fully coated in the oil, then push the majority of olives and sun-dried tomatoes to the side.

Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the feta is softened. Optionally, turn on the top broiler for 1 to 2 minutes to lightly brown the top of the feta. Just watch that you don\u0026#39;t burn the olives and sun-dried tomatoes.
Garnish with freshly chopped parsley and serve with crostini or sliced cucumber.
ingredients: 1 cup pitted olives, drained and halved
½ cup sun-dried tomatoes, drained and roughly chopped
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
table salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
roughly chopped fresh parsley, for garnish

title: Orange Chicken
description: This orange chicken recipe is sweet, sticky, and full of flavour. It’s simple to make, bringing the taste of takeout right to your kitchen.
steps: Gather all ingredients.

Combine water, rice vinegar, lemon juice, soy sauce, and orange juice for sauce into a saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir in brown sugar, green onion, orange zest, ginger, garlic, and pepper flakes; bring to a boil. Remove from heat, and cool for 10 to 15 minutes.
Place chicken in a resealable plastic bag. Pour in 1 cup cooled sauce. Seal the bag, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Reserve the remaining sauce.
Mix flour, salt, and pepper in another resealable plastic bag.
Remove chicken from the marinade and place into the bag of seasoned flour. Seal the bag and shake to coat.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken in the hot skillet until browned on both sides.
Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and cover with aluminum foil. Wipe out the skillet.
Pour reserved sauce into the skillet and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Mix together cornstarch and water until completely smooth. Stir into the boiling sauce.
Reduce heat to medium-low, add the chicken, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Serve over rice and enjoy!
ingredients: ½ teaspoon minced fresh ginger root
2 large skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into ½-inch cubes

title: Easy Fried Rice
description: This quick fried rice recipe is just like the one from your favorite Chinese restaurant. With leftover rice, eggs, carrots, peas, and soy sauce, it's a simple and tasty dish. Top with sliced green onions for extra flavour.
steps: Assemble ingredients.
Place carrots in a small saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a low boil and cook for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in peas, then immediately drain in a colander.
Heat a wok over high heat. Pour in vegetable oil, then stir in carrots, peas, and garlic; cook for about 30 seconds. Add eggs; stir quickly to scramble eggs with vegetables.
Stir in cooked rice. Add soy sauce and toss rice to coat. Drizzle with sesame oil and toss again.
Serve hot and enjoy!
ingredients: 1 clove garlic, minced, or to taste (Optional)
3 cups leftover cooked and chilled white rice
1 tablespoon soy sauce, or more to taste
2 teaspoons sesame oil, or to taste

title: Mediterranean Ground Beef Stir Fry
steps: Cook the tomatoes and bell pepper.Heat the oil in a large pan on medium-high heat. Add the bell pepper and cherry tomatoes and saute for 4 to 5 minutes, until the tomatoes are blistered and saucy. Add the garlic and stir another minute.

Add the spinach.Add the spinach and white parts of the green onion. Note that the spinach will take up most of the pan, but it will wilt down. Stir for another 2 to 3 minutes, until the spinach has wilted. Remove these veggies to a plate.

Cook the beef.Add the ground beef, oregano, salt, and black pepper to the pan, and use a spatula to break up the meat. Cook the ground beef until it\u0026#39;s browned, then drain off any excess grease.
Garnish and serve.Transfer the veggies back to the pan, add the green parts of the green onion, and stir until warmed through. Garnish with crumbled feta before serving.
ingredients: ▢1 red bell pepper, deseeded and diced
▢1 pint cherry tomatoes, sliced in half
▢2 green onion, thinly sliced, white and green parts separated
▢kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste

title: Balsamic Chicken and Brussels Sprouts
steps: Instructions
In a medium bowl, whisk together the balsamic vinegar, 2 tablespoons of olive oil, maple syrup, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Place the chicken thighs in a large glass bowl or plastic bag and pour the marinade on top. Marinate in the fridge for 1 to 2 hours.

Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Place the Brussels sprouts and onion on a sheet pan. Drizzle with the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Use your hands to mix everything together on the sheet pan.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place it on the sheet pan, nestling it between the vegetables. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.

While the chicken is baking, pour the remaining marinade into a small saucepan on medium-low heat. Simmer for 8 to 10 minutes or until the sauce is reduced and thickened. Open the oven, brush the glaze on the chicken and continue baking. Repeat this one more time while the chicken is baking. Note: the glaze will continue to thicken while it cools, so it will be much thicker on the second application.
Use an instant read thermometer to ensure the chicken is cooked through to 165°F (74°C), then serve.
ingredients: ▢½ teaspoon kosher salt, or more to taste
▢¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, or more to taste
▢1 pound Brussels sprouts, ends trimmed off and sliced in half

title: Mint Tea Punch
description: Tea, mint, sugar, orange and lemon juices make this a quick and easy, refreshingly delicious drink on a hot summer's day. Goes great with spicy foods.
steps: Place the tea bags and mint sprigs into a large pitcher. Pour boiling water over them, and allow to steep for about 8 minutes.
Remove and discard the tea bags and mint leaves, squeezing out excess liquid. Stir in sugar until dissolved, then stir in the orange juice and lemon juice. Pour in the cold water.
Serve over ice cubes, garnished with orange or lemon slices.

title: Greek Couscous Salad
description: A hearty couscous salad that's filling enough to enjoy as a complete meal.
steps: Pour water and chicken broth into a saucepan; stir in the garlic and bring to a boil. Stir in pearl couscous, cover the pan, and remove from heat. Allow couscous to stand until water has been absorbed, about 5 minutes; fluff with a fork. Allow couscous to cool to warm temperature.
Lightly toss couscous, chickpeas, sun-dried tomatoes, olives, and feta cheese in a large serving bowl.
To make the dressing: Mix white wine vinegar, lemon juice, oregano, and black pepper in a small bowl until well combined. Pour over couscous mixture; toss again to serve.
ingredients: 1 cup canned chickpeas (garbanzo beans), rinsed and drained

title: Spiral Cucumber Salad
description: This spiral cucumber salad features a sesame oil and soy dressing, plenty of gochujang red chili flakes, and a very fun way to cut cucumbers into spirals, delicious and beautiful to look at.
steps: Place cucumber between two chopsticks or wooden spoon handles and make diagonal cuts 1/8 -inch apart, taking care not to cut all the way through. Flip cucumber over and make cuts straight across on the second side taking care not to cut all the way through. Repeat with remaining cucumbers and place them in a large bowl. Sprinkle cucumbers liberally with salt, being sure to get salt into the crevices. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain liquid off cucumbers and submerge cucumbers in cold water to rinse off salt. Drain well and place cucumbers on paper towels to dry.

Add cucumbers, onions, garlic, gochugaro, soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, sesame oil, and sesame seeds to a large bowl; toss to coat. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve. Sprinkle with more sesame seeds if desired.
ingredients: 1/2 yellow or white onion, thinly sliced
2 teaspoons toasted sesame seeds, plus more for garnish if desired
